faq_heading: Ladner Elementary houses: your questions answered

faq.q: What did houses in Ladner Elementary sell for?
faq.a: 18 houses sold in Ladner Elementary between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,140,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Ladner Elementary?
faq.a: The median was 18 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.5% of the last list price (6% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most houses in Ladner Elementary sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 18 houses that sold in Ladner Elementary went for between $1,038,750 and $1,485,000, around a median of $1,140,000.

faq.q: Do houses in Ladner Elementary sell above asking price?
faq.a: 6% of the 18 houses sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 96.5% of it.

faq.q: How old are the houses that sold in Ladner Elementary?
faq.a: The median year built was 1972 for the 18 houses sold in Ladner Elementary.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do houses in Ladner Elementary usually have?
faq.a: The median house that sold in Ladner Elementary had 4 bedrooms, from the 18 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

What Ladner Elementary houses sold for, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026

18 houses sold in Ladner Elementary with a median price of $1,140,000 (the middle half sold between $1,038,750 and $1,485,000), taking a median of 18 days to sell at 96.5% of the last list price; 6% sold above list. They had a median $571 per square foot, a median year built of 1972 and a median lot of 7,086 square feet.
How Ladner Elementary compares with the rest of Ladner

The median house in Ladner Elementary sold for $1,140,000, 15% below the Ladner median of $1,340,000 across 117 sales. Ladner Elementary houses took a median 18 days to sell, against 16 days for Ladner as a whole.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a community is listed only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.
